description.value:
A diminutive people who dwell deep within the Black Shroud, sylphs resemble delicate dolls wrapped in vibrant leaves, relying on magic and illusion rather than physical combat.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Sylphs gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -4 Strength.
  • Size: Sylphs are Small creatures.
  • Type: Sylphs are fey with the sylph subtype.
  • Base Speed: Sylphs have a base speed of 20 feet and a fly speed of 40 feet (poor).
  • Languages: Sylphs start out with Sylvan and Common. Sylphs with high Intelligence scores can learn from: Elvaan, Mandragoran, Mithran, or Vieran.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Elemental Resistance: Sylphs have lightning resistance 5.
  • Magic Resistant: Sylphs get a +1 racial saving throw bonus against spells or spell-like effects.
  • Spell Resistance, Lesser: Sylphs gain spell resistance equal to 6 + their character level.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Beguiling Liar: Sylphs gain a +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks to convince an opponent a lie is true.
  • Camouflage: Sylphs gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks in forested terrain.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Fey Magic: Sylphs add +1 to the DC of illusion spells and gain spell-like abilities: 1/day—hidden presence; 3/week—charm, lesser confusion, sleep.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Sylphs have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.
